product_overview: Tuiglo is an Arabic-first, RTL e-commerce website for browsing and purchasing bags and accessories across Morocco. Customers can explore the three catalog categories, compare product details, manage a cart, and place cash-on-delivery orders through checkout.
core_goals: Browse products by category and open individual product detail pages
View product images, specifications, and pricing before purchase
Add items to cart, adjust quantities, and remove items as needed
Complete guest checkout by entering shipping and contact information
Review the order summary and submit a cash-on-delivery order

features.name: Product Browsing & Category Navigation
features.description: Customers can explore the store catalog from the homepage, move into one of the three categories, and open product detail pages to review individual items.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a category -> Browse product listings -> Open a product page -> View product images, specifications, and price
Navigate to / -> Choose a category card -> Review the category catalog -> Open another product from the list -> Compare product details
Navigate to / -> Move between the three catalog categories -> Browse available products in each category -> Open a product page -> View the image gallery

features.name: Shopping Cart Management
features.description: Customers can add products to the cart, review chosen items, change quantities, and remove items before checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /[category]/[product] -> Add a product to cart -> Open /cart -> Review cart items and subtotal -> Proceed to checkout
Navigate to /cart -> Increase an item quantity -> Decrease an item quantity -> Remove an item from the cart -> See the cart update
Navigate to /[category]/[product] -> Add a product to cart -> Open /cart -> Adjust quantities -> Return to shopping

features.name: Order Placement & Checkout
features.description: Customers can enter contact and shipping details, review the order summary, choose delivery information, and submit a cash-on-delivery order.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Enter full name -> Enter email address -> Enter phone number -> Enter shipping address -> Select shipping method -> Review the order summary -> Place the order -> View the order confirmation screen
Navigate to /checkout -> Enter incomplete or invalid contact details -> Attempt to place the order -> See validation feedback -> Correct the form inputs -> Submit the order
Navigate to /checkout -> Review subtotal, shipping, and total -> Place the order -> View confirmation -> Continue shopping

routes.description: Tuiglo e-commerce home page featuring hero section, product categories, and featured items
Category catalog listing products for backpacks, lunch-boxes, or cross-body-bags
Product details page with image gallery, product specs, pricing, and Add to Cart
Shopping cart page showing added items, quantity adjustments, item removal, and subtotal
Checkout page with customer contact, shipping address, order summary, and order submission
